question: 'GOAL' is an autobiography of which famous Indian player.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Major Dhyan Chand.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hockey magician Dhyan Chand's autobiography titled "Goal" was published in 1952.**
 
• **Dhyan Singh joined the Indian Army **at the age of 16 and started playing hockey there.
 
• GOAL, published by Sportstar, is a 261-page book where Dhyan Chand takes the reader on his hockey journey.
 
• But for memories of his playing days, the legendary forward gives important tips on the technicality of the sport.
